messages.subject: Project Larkspur — heads of terms
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Following the call, here is where we land on the headline commercials for the CAL-218 licence: £8m upfront, milestones up to £62m, royalties 7-12%, plus a £3m option fee on CAL-301. We'd want exclusivity for 60 days while we paper it. Happy to send our draft term sheet.

Oliver Jennings
Birchall Stone LLP
